  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recurrence_rule VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT 'weekly, biweekly, monthly, or NULL for one-time',

  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recurrence_end_date TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT 'Last date to generate occurrences'
